declared.freeze: screen and replicate need a committed model_specs/cb8_v1.json carrying b_analysis_rules_sha256 and b_data_rules_sha256 equal to the code's
interpretations: Units are (market-day, checkpoint) at t_end - {300, 120, 60} s; t_end - 600 s is reported only. A daily market is its own event, so the event way is the market id (market-day).

Unit labels in order: source_unavailable (market states status not ok / book_unavailable), features_unavailable (no strike or < 55 sigma returns), z_below, state_missing, book_unavailable (favoured token has events but no book snapshot; its own label, never 'no trade'), stale (not fresh, incl. a token without events), crossed, no_trade (no ask or ask > 0.99), no_trade_size (ask <= 0.99 but < 5 shares), traded.
Coverage for the GB 'no opportunity' reading counts only market-days with states status 'ok' as source-available (book_unavailable market-days count as unavailable: conservative).

Y_fav comes only from the guarded Gamma outcome (labels give the price order). Only decisive outcomes (1/0, 0/1, 0.5/0.5 within 1e-6) are used; a traded unit with another value is 'outcome_unavailable': dropped from the primary estimate and added back as a total loss (y = 0) in the binding worst case (2.6 v).

Source check: Binance outcome Up iff settlement close > K_d, Down iff <, tie iff equal; computed on every split market-day (kept, not seal-dropped) with a decisive Gamma outcome, a strike and a settlement candle; > 2% disagreement -> B not testable (source). Disagreeing units stay in the P&L with the Gamma outcome. Market-days without a Binance outcome are counted, not disagreement.

The p condition: n >= 100 and >= 30 market-day clusters; one-sided p = max over the market-day way (CR1 at G >= 30) and the UTC-day way iff G_day >= 15 (small-G rule, A-C1); with G_day < 15 the leave-one-day-out sign rule binds. The same p condition (with A-C1) is used inside the placebo and every robustness branch.
Cost robustness (2.6 i): net' = y - (a + 0.0075) - max(f(a), f(a + 0.0075)) (the larger fee, conservative on either side of 0.5); the traded set is unchanged; B1 keeps mean net > 0.
Top-5 robustness (2.6 ii): drop the 5 market-days, and separately the 5 UTC days, with the largest absolute summed net; the p condition and the 0.5c floor must still hold.
Sign by month (2.6 iv): months with >= 30 traded units; mean net > 0 in >= two thirds of them. With no qualifying month the check is unverified (None) and blocks an advance.

Latency (2.6 vi): fill at a* = max(a_t, a_{t+10 s}) only if the stored t + 10 s ask ladder offers >= 5 shares at <= a* and a* <= 0.99, fee rate max(recorded at t, at t + 10 s, docs 0.07); unfilled units are dropped (counted); mean > 0, >= half of B1 and the day-unit tail gate on the filled units.
Sigma-30 robustness (2.6 vii) rebuilds the units with sigma from 30 candles (>= 28 returns), so the eligible and traded sets may differ; mean > 0 and >= half of B1.

Break-even placebo: one uniform per UTC day shared by every traded unit of that day, Y' = 1{U_d < a + f}; advance = the p condition (floor off) AND the day-unit tail gate; 200 draws, seed 8181; calibrated iff the advance rate <= 1.5%.

Certainty attribution: B1_low on units with 1 <= |z| < 3 buying the market favourite (higher mid; both tokens need a book with bid and ask; ties excluded) at its ask <= 0.99 with >= 5 shares, fresh and not crossed; credited iff B1 - B1_low >= |B1| / 2; no B1_low unit -> not credited (unverified).

Stage 2 uses p < alpha2 / k_used everywhere the Stage-1 rule uses 0.01 (core, placebo, robustness): k_used = 1 + the other CB8 tests that advanced or whose Stage-1 file does not exist yet (an unknown test is assumed to reach Stage 2: conservative; early finishers are judged against alpha / k).
GB is applied at both stages on the stage's own units (identical gates). A failed gate, an audit FAIL, unverified disjointness or the source check makes B1 'not testable', p = 1, still counted.

BY triage label: p <= q / (m H_m) with m = battery2.cumulative_count() at run time (the strictest BY rank). Stage-1 batch-Holm label: k1 = 3, alpha 0.01, tests without a final Stage-1 file enter as p = 1.
Seal-time drops: markets with a DROPPED_* block in updown/drops.csv.gz are removed from every count and estimate (only their ids are read).
The cumulative count recorded is battery2.cumulative_count() on the trials file the run appends to; the host union step (scripts/oracle/union_jsonl.py) is run by the operator before the job.

target.net: Y_fav - a - f(a), f = r a (1 - a), r = max(recorded, docs crypto 0.07)
